rationale: In the Week 1 study, RSI was the only one of the four indicators to post a positive out-of-sample Sharpe ratio after costs (0.33). It was also the only mean-reversion rule tested -- the other three are trend-following, and all three went negative net of costs. It still lost to buy & hold, which is why this portfolio publishes both side by side. It is being traded live because a rule that survived one honest test deserves a second one that cannot be re-run.
